arguments.subject: Order PO-8281
arguments.body:
Dear Harbor Tools Inc.,

Please find attached our order PO-8281. We require delivery by 17 January 2027. The total value of the order is 5,224.50 EUR.

Could Paolo Ferri please confirm this order in writing?

Additionally, as requested, we have attached a document regarding the number of people working on the line.

Best regards,

Acme Components
